node.reading: This page is a technical verification annex to the public-facing foundation article . It is not the canonical source or a standalone article. For the authoritative technical material, use the canonical Ecosystem Positioning README and the versioned sources it indexes. This annex makes the six positive paths and their quality plans inspectable and traceable. Publication on Tegrity.AI does not imply peer review, independent validation, production readiness, adoption as a standard or endorsement by the ITU, FG-TIDA or any cited organisation.
node.readingSummary: This page is a technical verification annex to the public-facing foundation article .

relations: A fair modernization comparison should preserve the same operational obligations, information access and compute budget.
Las rutas EA son fixtures y protocolos de un dominio distinto. No equivalen a un benchmark de xSeil ni acreditan superioridad de un planificador.
Maturity claims become more inspectable when each transition is tied to observable execution, exception handling and handover evidence.
Es una propuesta de evaluación; no atribuye al modelo una certificación ni traslada automáticamente los resultados formales EA.
A quantum formulation needs a fixed task and a competent classical baseline with preparation, readout and verification costs included.
Una formulación potencial no demuestra speedup, hardware cuántico usado ni superioridad práctica.
A fair replay should reveal late evidence only when it became available and score the original decision separately from its later repair.
Es una condición propuesta para la prueba; no se ha ejecutado aquí un nuevo benchmark.
For a complementary reading, see [The six positive paths and their quality plans](https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-annex-5-six-positive-paths-and-quality-plans/).
For a complementary reading, see [Ablation, sufficiency and bounded extensibility](https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-annex-6-ablation-sufficiency-and-extensibility/).
